name: CSUMB SCC_Block04 inspected native bathymetry and terrain-habitat grids

producer.name: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab (CSUMB/SFML)

units.rough_smooth_terrain_class: coded 2 m cells; -1/-31 rough and 0/-30 smooth

rights.license: US federal archive distribution; original CSUMB product redistribution terms still under review

spatial.horizontal_crs: EPSG:26910 for inspected ArcInfo grids; WGS84 bounds are the separate NCEI track envelope

temporal.update_cadence: Static 2010 survey; monthly catalog check for revised releases, no automatic native-data replacement.

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI archive of CSUMB observations, not an independent survey
transformations: Opened exact bathymetry and habitat ArcInfo grids from the hash-pinned original archive; no datum conversion, interpolation or fishing target generation

evidence.supports: Primary NCEI survey page identifies original CSUMB survey and 2010-03-20 through 2010-08-10 acquisition interval.

Complete original archive opened and SHA-256 verified: b7bd52f6ba39ec328c8d45763d7589d0d329fb0d597d8537492868f9a74f8b9a. The 2 m EPSG:26910 bathymetry grid has 7,699,899 valid cells; the aligned terrain grid has 7,668,985. The displayed WGS84 box bounds the valid cells but is not a full wet-cell geometry. Exact audit: dist/data/csumb-scc-native-source-review.json.

limitations: Original grids are inspected for measured coverage only. NAVD88 elevations need a reviewed local chart-datum transformation before any depth gate. Rough terrain codes are not independent rock samples. Per-cell uncertainty, hazards, protected areas and local fishing rules remain to be reconciled; no public target or export is supported yet.
The 2 m rough/smooth terrain class is derived from the same bathymetry and is not independent rock groundtruth.
The WGS84 box is the valid-cell bounding envelope only; it includes unmeasured holes and is not a complete survey footprint.
Producer redistribution terms for native and derived grids remain unreviewed; no public target or map export is approved.
